messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: ggplot2 case study competition
parts:
Hi everyone,

While the case study competition closed in August, I completely forgot
about judging it. Please read the case studies on the ggplot2 wiki
(http://ggplot2.wik.is/) and then vote for your favourite two here:
http://hadley.wufoo.com/forms/ggplot2-case-study-competition/. The
two winners will each receive a book of their choice from Springer's
useR series, thanks to the generous sponsorship of Springer.

Thanks!

Hadley

--
http://had.co.nz/
